2026-09-10T16:45Z.note: REAL FIX SHIPPED. QQQ CLOSED: peaked +47.73%, gave the ENTIRE gain back to close at -2.27% (closed_reason=ratchet). exit_detail literally said 'the protective floor exits so the green trade cannot finish red' -- yet it closed red. Traced root cause in src/lib/zerodte/exit-engine.ts: buildExitContext's mark_honored flag compared two ALREADY-ROUNDED values (mark !== markObserved); the raw observed print (0.215) rounds UP to the exact same cent as the 0% floor (0.22), so the flag read false even though resolveExitMark's own Math.max(raw values) correctly picked the floor. pnl_pct then branched on the wrong flag and used the raw (worse) print instead of the floor-honored mark. Fixed: resolveExitMark now returns {mark, honored} directly from the SAME raw comparison Math.max uses -- single source of truth. RED->GREEN proven (git-stash the production fix, keep the new test: 81/83 pre-fix with 2 real failures reproducing this exact shape; 83/83 post-fix). tsc --noEmit clean. open_findings.status: CONFIRMED SYSTEMIC (upgraded 2026-09-10T06:03:35Z from single-instance to 7-instance pattern via 90-day record backtest)
open_findings.summary: Near-instant (<5s of commit) 'stopped' exits at catastrophic P&L (-51% to -90%) are a recurring, mechanical, NOT-real-trade artifact, distinct from and NOT fixed by PR #4656 (which only addressed the near-zero thesis_break self-veto shape). Root cause: entry_premium falls back to stale flow_avg_fill (src/lib/zerodte/plan.ts:511-524, resolveLedgerEntryPremium) when planEntryMax is null and no fresh quote is required; CHASE_PCT's 55% no-chase guard is wider than the play's own -50% hard stop, so a 'not chasing' entry (48-54% already decayed) can already be past its own stop the instant a fresh mark is taken at commit.
